title: fix(telegram): bot-to-bot replies are not bounded by bot-loop protection
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Telegram peer-bot updates currently omit authoritative bot-pair facts, so admitted exchanges bypass the shared configured loop budget and cause repeated model turns.

Preserves @amittell's contributor implementation and feeds Telegram's authoritative native bot-author facts into the existing shared bot-loop guard. Group sender-chat/anonymous identities and self messages do not become peer-bot facts. Suppressed turns log the existing diagnostic and restore/cancel acknowledgement status through the current reaction finalizer.

No new configuration, SDK exports or guard counter. Telegram documentation now describes admission and existing budget controls. The existing native-handler regression is strengthened without test-line growth (34 added / 34 removed).

## Evidence

[Real Telegram Test Server two-bot evidence, limits, and focused checks](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/151924#issuecomment-6520370049).

Two Convex-leased Test Server bots, Bot-to-Bot enabled: main exceeds configured budget2/60s twice without guard facts; candidate suppresses third peer input twice, records diagnostic, performs Telegram-accepted ACK cleanup, and answers human control once. Reaction evidence is API-level, not a visual thinking transition. Default20/60 does not solve the reported historical slow loop.

Focused native-handler regression is red on pinned main (3 bot dispatches instead of2), green on candidate; targeted Oxfmt/Oxlint pass. No full-suite claim. Exact-head CI and review requested after push.
